text_block_list.text:
One day after training— Tokai Teio catches 
sight of Mejiro McQueen staying behind to 
keep running.

Continuing to train and grow steadily, 
Tokai Teio pushes onward.

Because of that, she couldn't bring 
herself to believe Symboli Rudolf's words 
that "the outcome of a match isn't always 
destined to be the same."

Determined to prove Symboli Rudolf's 
prediction wrong, Tokai Teio challenged 
Mejiro McQueen to a mock race.

And as for the results of the race— just 
as Symboli Rudolf had predicted, it ended 
in victory for Mejiro McQueen.
